# Test plan for .github/workflows/fork-test-runner.yml (fork-only; never merged upstream).
# One row per change under review. Pipe-separated, blank lines and # comments ignored.
#
#   branch | test file | source file | -k expression | suite dir ("-") | base ref (default main)
#
# The base ref is resolved as origin/<base> first, then verbatim.
# PREFER A RAW SHA. A branch-relative rev such as <branch>~2 is unsafe on a
# branch mergify can update: on 2026-09-10 it merged main into an approved PR
# branch, so <branch>~1 became the fix under test and BEFORE passed. Always
# check the 'HEAD = <sha> (<subject>)' line the runner prints for BEFORE.
#
# The runner checks out <branch>'s test file on top of main and runs the -k
# selection (expected red), then checks out the branch and runs the whole file
# (expected green). If a suite dir is given it runs `pytest -m cpu_test <dir>`
# on main and on the branch so unrelated environment failures are visible as
# identical on both sides.

# ACTIVE 2026-09-14, PR 54283 -- the PR was 791 commits behind main and
# upstream had changed both hasher.py (#53675) and get_mm_hashes itself
# (#54241 media_io_kwargs, #54918 modality scoping), so re-verify that the
# collisions still exist on current main after merging it in.
# VERIFIED (run 34873264781) on 0d949f8e5c: BEFORE 6 failed / 1 passed with
# byte-identical digests; AFTER 25 passed. Suite tests/multimodal: main 23f/547p
# vs branch 23f/554p, the 23 identical on both sides (uninspectable models).
# retired 2026-09-17: verified, run 35262753719 (molmo2 1f->6p; is_embed 2f->22p, suite main 40p/0f vs branch 56p/0f)
